docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:49:PLOS seed taxonomy includes:
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:53:| starter seeds | Low-risk first action when full path authority is incomplete. | Must be labeled as starter guidance, not full source-backed pathing. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:54:| capability seeds | Reusable capability building blocks. | Must retain source, claim, requirement, and freshness links. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:55:| proof seeds | Evidence or receipt requirements needed before, during, or after execution. | Must bind to proof requirements and privacy class. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:56:| requirement seeds | Required conditions, documents, equipment, rules, or constraints. | Must carry requirement source state and review/freshness state. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:57:| prerequisite seeds | Before-you-start dependencies. | Must block or sequence Steps when missing. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:58:| recovery seeds | Safe recovery routes after interruption, failure, or changed reality. | Must avoid shame and preserve proof/reflow receipts. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:59:| replacement seeds | Alternative path candidates when a Step or path no longer fits. | Must preserve source authority and reason for replacement. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:60:| elasticity seeds | Shrink, extend, defer, split, merge, or re-scope behavior. | Must respect source, risk, and deadline envelopes. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:61:| path overlay seeds | Reusable overlays for role, path, requirement, proof, or projection variants. | Must identify dependency packs and overlay IDs. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:62:| momentum-tail seeds | Small follow-through actions that keep continuity after completion. | Must be optional and not become streak/score pressure. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:63:| jurisdiction seeds | Jurisdiction, age, eligibility, school, legal, travel, certification, or rule-specific constraints. | Must block authoritative pathing when jurisdiction is unknown. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:64:| deadline-protection seeds | Actions or reflows that protect a date or deadline. | Must be tied to deadline physics and source authority. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:65:| resource-light seeds | Lower-capacity alternatives when time, energy, money, access, or attention is constrained. | Must not erase proof or safety requirements. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:66:| location-compatible seeds | Location, access, mobility, or environment-compatible variants. | Must preserve privacy and local context boundaries. |
docs/codex/SEED_BASED_PLANNING_LAW.md:67:| split/merge seeds | Decompose or combine Steps when scale changes. | Must keep receipts and source traceability. |

docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:9:This law defines Source Atlas as always-running source authority for PLOS execution. It does not implement source freshness, change existing Source Atlas models, alter R2 distribution, add pack payloads, or rename existing types. If this law conflicts with active truth files, the truth files win and this law must be repaired before any dependent issue closes Green.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:13:Source Atlas is operational architecture, not a static content library.

docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:62:Source Atlas authority covers these responsibilities:
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:66:| Source truth | Claims that affect runtime behavior must bind to source records, local proof, or an explicit source-needed state. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:67:| Source freshness | Runtime eligibility depends on freshness, review date, expiration, changed claims, and stale/revoked handling. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:68:| Source revocation | Revoked sources cannot drive Recommended step, schedule install, share eligibility, or official-current claims. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:74:| Runtime eligibility | Only eligible source states may drive Recommended step, schedule install, or runtime expansion. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:83:| official-current | Official or approved source, current freshness, approved review, applicable envelope, and acceptable risk. | Eligible for Recommended step and schedule install when all envelope checks pass. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:85:| maintainer-curated | Curated by Ambitions or trusted maintainers with recorded provenance. | Eligible only if freshness, review, risk, and envelope pass. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:87:| local-proof-only | Locally verified by user proof or local receipt, without public source authority. | Can shape local execution when safe; not official source truth or share authority. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:91:| jurisdiction-needed | Applicability depends on location, age, school, professional, legal, medical, travel, certification, or rule context. | Cannot drive schedule install or authoritative pathing until jurisdiction is known. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:94:| contradicted | Claims conflict with current source, another source, or local proof. | Blocked until resolved. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:95:| revoked | Source, claim, pack, or eligibility has been revoked. | Blocked and must roll back or degrade. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:109:| Affects another goal | cross-goal consequence, source conflict, proof or schedule collision | This path has consequences elsewhere in the user's life system. |
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:110:| Deadline at risk | deadline-sensitive source/risk/freshness state affects timing | Time reality threatens safe execution. |

docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:127:- source or pack version
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:131:- revocation or rollback pointer when applicable
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:137:Only eligible states can drive Recommended step or schedule install.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:142:- freshness is current enough for the risk class
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:146:- no contradiction, revocation, blocked state, or unresolved source change is present
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:149:If any of those checks fail, PLOS must use source-needed, needs-review, starter-guidance-only, local-proof-only, jurisdiction-needed, high-risk guarded, or blocked behavior as appropriate. It must not call the result source-backed Green.
docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:155:- Any Goal Solution Loop: goal intake must route source-needed, jurisdiction-needed, high-risk, coverage-demand, and unsupported states without fake pathing.

docs/codex/SOURCE_ATLAS_AUTHORITY_LAW.md:159:- Life Consequence Reflow: source changes that affect another goal must surface as cross-goal consequence, not hidden reranking.

docs/codex/STEP_ELASTICITY_RUNTIME_LAW.md:56:| deadline-protecting version | A version that preserves a deadline, checkpoint, or expiring source condition. | Reducing deadline value without a receipt. |
docs/codex/STEP_ELASTICITY_RUNTIME_LAW.md:57:| momentum-tail version | Optional follow-through after completion or extra capacity. | Turning momentum into streak, score, guilt, or goal cannibalization. |
